record.field: ${ 'Payment from ' + ctx.get('partner_name', '') + ' has been received.' if ctx.get('partner_name') else 'New Payment has been received.' }

field.name: body_html
field.div:
Hello ${ctx.get('recipient_name', 'User')},
% if ctx.get('partner_name'):
Payment of ${ctx.get('amount', '')} has been received from ${ctx['partner_name']} in ${ctx.get('journal_name', '')}. % else:
Payment of ${ctx.get('amount', '')} has been received from an unidentified Partner in ${ctx.get('journal_name', '')}. % endif
You can go ahead to process the Payment by applying it to the respective Customer Invoice(s).
Best regards,
${user.company_id.name}
